thread:
nina: Quick experiment idea — "SparkFlow" mini-launch. 20m demo + benchmark one-pager + prompt kit. Offer 500 tokens at signup + 500 attendee bonus. KPI: +12% first-API-call within 72h.

aditya: timeline? recommend landing + tracking by Tue, webinar Thu. growth run paid + organic.

colleen: gating note: auto-apply 500 at signup, require attendee "Claim 500" click in modal to reduce abuse. modal should include runnable prompt + single-click run.

ben: growth okay. budget ~$1.5k. channels: Twitter devs, GitHub placements, newsletter. Can do a small Reddit test if we have budget.

aditya: landing dev note: include cohort param `?utm_campaign=sparkflow_0915&cohort={{cohort}}&variant={{variant}}` and a canary flag. PR will include instrumentation.

analytics-bot: New event: `sparkflow_credit_claimed` with properties ["utm_campaign","cohort","variant","attended","utm_source"]. Dashboard tile requested, owner: colleen/growth.

nina: can we also create a short benchmark narrative (one-pager) showing latency/cost baselines + batching & kv-cache tips? that'll be useful in the post and for sales.

colleen: yes please. design brief: minimal, developer-first, show a code snippet + cost per 1k tokens example. Also include note: credits valid on hosted API only; Private customers contact AE.

aditya: UX: claim modal should surface a tiny code snippet and a pre-filled runnable prompt, e.g.:
```
client.generate("Summarize these meeting notes", max_tokens=120)
```
And a button: "Run with credits". reduces friction.

ops-bot: Preview page live: https://preview.redwood.app/sparkflow-0915 (expires 48h).

ben: routing ask: attribute claimed credits to utm_source. Also, if a user claims >2000 tokens or shows high usage, tag inbound lead and route to sales queue. add `lead_score=auto` in event.

colleen: will ensure event payload includes utm fields and a high-usage flag for routing. Also add a privacy callout on the claim page.

nina: action recap: aditya = landing + claim modal + PR; colleen = copy + dashboard + benchmark one-pager; ben = paid buys + audience + canary; ops-bot = preview + recording upload. Sync Wed EOD for final go/no-go. :sparkles:
